skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The alchemist outfit Thorns wears when charting a course using alchemy.
The set comes festooned with accessories, but as Thorns quickly found out, each has a practical use.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
He has set sail on his course.
He will find the bricks to build the future out in the lost, unknown seas. Nothing can stay his course to ever-distant waters.

skins.name: Boundless Sail
skins.content: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Boundless Sail. Exercise attire based on a fencer's protective clothes. Offers both comfort and fashion alongside all-day defense.
skins.usage: One of Thorns the Lodestar's exercise outfits.
skins.quote: If all of existence is boundless, then his heart shall be as a boundless sail. Unperturbed by the billowing waves, he sails forward, sword in hand.
